annotations.label: Spear-phish SMS (customer-reported)
annotations.note: Post-incident interview: customer reports an SMS referencing her real $47 Tamsinmere to Jamie K. (sent Fri 21:14) with a link to a near-perfect fake banking page; credentials and the OTP seed were harvested. Roughly 48 hours of silence follow before the takeover login - mid-band dwell (half of phished accounts are accessed within 12h, 91% within a week; Agari 2021).

sop.what: A successful authentication from a device never seen on the account.
sop.brief: Authenticated login from a device never seen on this account. Passing 2FA does not clear it; phishing harvests codes too. Verify via details on file. Review the session's next actions.

sop.what: A rapid burst of account-profile changes (email, phone, password, payee) in one session.
sop.why: Two rapid changes is elevated; three or more is high.
sop.brief: Several account-recovery changes within minutes, one session. The velocity is the signal, not any single edit. Confirm with the customer out-of-band before honoring a new email or phone, and hold payee additions made in the same burst.
